The Tools menu

The wrench icon in the top bar opens SATOM's helper tools — regex and network calculators, the certificate inspector, the false-positive explainer, and the support entries. The transaction tracer is now a page under Operations → Troubleshooting.

👤 ForViewerOperatorAdministrator
🔑 Permissionsmonitoring.probe_free users.manage
📍 WhereTop bar → wrench icon (Tools), on every page

What is it?#

The Tools menu is the wrench icon in the top bar (tooltip Tools), to the right of the product switcher. It is present on every page, in every ADOM, and it opens small helper tools as pop-up windows over the page you are on — you never lose your place.

Most entries are pure calculators. The certificate inspector's Probe a host tab makes the SATOM server open a network connection on your behalf; it is permission-gated and audited. The transaction tracer, which does the same, left this menu on 2026-10-16 and is a page under Operations → Troubleshooting — see Transaction tracer.

What the menu contains#

The menu is grouped by dividers. Items appear in this order:

Group Menu item What it opens Who sees it
Regex Regex calculator The regex lab on its Match tester tab Every signed-in user
Regex Regex cheat sheet The regex lab on its Cheat sheet tab Every signed-in user
Regex Pattern library The regex lab on its Library tab Every signed-in user
Network Network calculator IPv4 subnet calculator Every signed-in user
Analysis Certificate inspector Chain, expiry and hostname checker Every signed-in user; using it needs any read permission (for example monitoring.view), free-target probing needs <a class="dc-perm" href="permissions.html#monitoring-probe_free" title="Probe free targets — Point the certificate inspector and the transaction tracer at a
host SATOM does not manage. Inventory destinations never need this.">monitoring.probe_free
Analysis False-positive explainer Attack-log entry → recommended carve-out Every signed-in user
Support Report a problem Bug-report form sent to the administrators Every signed-in user
Support Release Notes Vendor firmware release-notes browser Only in the FortiWeb, FortiGate, FortiADC, FortiAuthenticator and FortiAnalyzer ADOMs
Support Bug Reports The administrators' bug-report inbox Users with users.manage (shows a red counter of open reports)

ℹ️Note

Report a problem, Release Notes and Bug Reports used to live in the user (avatar) menu. They are now in the Tools menu; the user menu only holds Profile, Language and Sign Out.

The tools at a glance#

Regex calculator, cheat sheet and pattern library#

One window, four tabs, for testing a regular expression against sample values and previewing the URL a rewrite rule produces. The same window opens from the .* button next to regex-capable fields on the Exceptions page and in the object editor, where it gains a Use this pattern button that copies the pattern back into the field. See Regex lab.

Network calculator#

IPv4 subnet math that runs entirely in your browser (no request is sent to the server). Enter an address in CIDR form (192.0.2.0/24) or address-and-mask form (192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0); it shows the network, broadcast, netmask, wildcard mask, host range and host count, can split a block into smaller subnets, and answers Is this IP inside? for a given address. The Split into / field takes the smaller prefix to split into. Invalid input is reported as Invalid IP. or Prefix must be 0–32.

Certificate inspector#

Paste a certificate or fullchain, or probe a live TLS endpoint, and get the chain in order with every link verified, expiry, key size, hostname coverage and an optional private-key match. See Certificate inspector.

False-positive explainer#

Paste a FortiWeb attack-log entry (syslog key=value, JSON, or a raw HTTP request) and see which module blocked it, which carve-out fits and the exact payload SATOM would build. It never saves. See False-positive explainer.

Transaction tracer (moved)#

Since 2026-10-16 the tracer is a page: Operations → Troubleshooting → Transaction Tracer, in every ADOM. See Transaction tracer.

Report a problem, Release Notes, Bug Reports#

  • Report a problem sends a short report (title and description; the page address and your browser are captured automatically) to every administrator. See Bug reports.
  • Release Notes browses Fortinet's published release notes for the firmware of the ADOM's product and compares two versions. See Release notes.
  • Bug Reports is the administrators' inbox for those reports.

Other tools that are not in this menu#

Some tools are reached from the left-hand sidebar instead:

Tool Where Article
Scout (AI assistant, formerly AI Advisor) Sidebar → Operations → Troubleshooting → Scout (every ADOM) Scout
Plugin Studio (Script Library, Python Console, Data stores, Connections, API Catalog, Apps) Administrator → Studio → Plugin Studio, in every ADOM Script Library, Python Console, Data stores, Connections, API Catalog, Apps
Report Studio and Custom Views Global → Administrator → Studio (Report Studio only); every device ADOM → Plugins Report Studio and Custom Views
Lua Studio Global → Administrator → Studio; FortiWeb/FortiADC → Plugins Lua Studio
Sentinel Global → Monitoring → Sentinel Sentinel

Each Studio entry is shown only to holders of its own permission (studio.python_console, studio.plugin_studio, studio.lua_studio). In the Global ADOM, a profile without users.manage that holds one of them gets a standalone Studio group instead of the sub-menu under Administrator.

ℹ️Note

Changed in 2.11.0: the Global ADOM has its own Studio group (it used to sit inside Administrator, visible only with users.manage), and the certificate inspector and transaction tracer need a read permission instead of sign-in alone.

ℹ️Note

Changed in 3.1.0: the Global Studio group is a sub-menu at the foot of Administrator again; profiles without users.manage keep the standalone group.

Permissions#

Opening the Tools menu needs nothing beyond being signed in. Individual tools add their own gates:

  • The certificate inspector and the transaction tracer need any read permission (the coarse view key, granted for example by monitoring.view); without one their requests return 403.
  • monitoring.probe_free lets the certificate inspector and the transaction tracer reach a host that is not in your appliance inventory, and lets the tracer send POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE. Users who hold users.manage are treated as having it as well.
  • users.manage shows the Bug Reports entry.
  • Release Notes is only offered while you are in the FortiWeb, FortiGate, FortiADC, FortiAuthenticator or FortiAnalyzer ADOM.

Troubleshooting#

A tool window does not open#

Possible causes - The page was still loading its scripts when you clicked.

Solution 1. Reload the page and open the menu again.

Verification - The tool appears as a pop-up window over the current page.

"Release Notes" is missing from the menu#

Possible causes - You are in the Global ADOM. The entry is only offered in the FortiWeb, FortiADC, FortiAuthenticator and FortiAnalyzer ADOMs.

Solution 1. Switch to a product ADOM with the product switcher.

Verification - The Release Notes item appears below Report a problem.
